title: Director of Operations
text:
**Director of Operations**

**Livingston County Water and Sewer Authority | Lakeville, New York**

**Salary:$110,000-$130,000 | First Review: December 4, 2026**

**Lead Essential Operations. Develop the Workforce. Prepare for Growth.**

The Livingston County Water and Sewer Authority (LCWSA) is seeking an experienced water and wastewater operations professional to help guide its operations through a period of significant growth and expansion.

Over the past five years, the Authority has expanded its water system by 20% while assuming responsibility for additional treatment facilities. With further growth anticipated, LCWSA is investing in its infrastructure, operations, and workforce to meet increasing demands.

The Director of Operations oversees the Authority's water distribution and sewer collection systems, including maintenance activities, field resources, staff development, regulatory compliance, and a $3.5 million operating budget.

**The Opportunity**

The next Director of Operations will help prepare LCWSA for continued expansion while strengthening daily operations and developing its workforce. Priorities include preventive maintenance, infrastructure planning, effective use of operational resources, and training and mentoring employees as experienced team members approach retirement.

LCWSA seeks a collaborative, hands-on leader who combines practical field experience and technical expertise with sound judgment, organizational skills, and a commitment to staff development. The successful candidate will build strong relationships with employees, Authority leadership, municipal partners, contractors, and regulatory agencies while ensuring safe, reliable service to the communities LCWSA serves.

**Qualifications**

Candidates must meet **one** of the following education and experience requirements:

● A bachelor's degree in engineering, construction, or environmental science, plus four years of qualifying experience; or

● An associate's degree in water/wastewater technology or a related field, plus six years of qualifying experience; or

● A high school diploma or equivalent, plus eight years of qualifying experience.

Qualifying experience must be in water treatment, water distribution, sewer collection or treatment, or construction of water and sewer facilities.

All candidates must have at least three years of cumulative supervisory or leadership experience, which may include employee supervision, project management, operational oversight, or coordination of work activities. A valid driver's license and safe driving record are required.

An engineering background may be beneficial but is not required.

**Compensation & Benefits**

The salary range is **$110,000-$130,000**. Benefits include fully paid health insurance, employer contributions to a Health Savings Account (HSA), participation in the New York State Retirement System, and paid time off.

This is an on-site position based in Lakeville, New York. Livingston County residency is preferred but not required. Relocation assistance may be negotiated.

**Ready to Explore the Opportunity?**

Applications will be accepted until the position is filled. A first review of candidates will be 12/4/26.

To apply, submit a resume and cover letter through the Pracademic Partners Recruitment Portal:

https://www.pracademicpartners.com/current-recruitments
